title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Hotel Restaurant Amendment Act 2013

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Hotel Restaurant Amendment Act 2013
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

AN
The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Hotel & Restaurant
(Amendment) Act, 2013
AN
ACT
to amend the Pakistan Hotels and Restaurants
Act, 1976.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the
Pakistan Hotels and Restaurants Act, 1976
(Act No. LXXXI of 1976), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Hotels and Restaurants (Amendment) Act, 2013.
(1) It extends to the whole of the
Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

(1) Any owner, who fails to apply for registration
within the time specified in section 5,

Where the failure persists upto six months, the
